messages:
claire: Quick heads-up — scheduling a short-change window 04:15 UTC. Plan: pin runtime v2.7.0 + api v2.1.0. Console is a flag flip only. Need router handshake-guard validation for header permutation introduced by new batching. @dev-router @alex can you run a fast staging check? deploy-bot will run a dry-run.

deploy-bot: dry-run scheduled in 18m. Freeze enforced 10m before window. /deploy preflight: no DB migrations detected.

dev-router: Ran smoke on staging. Saw intermittent 502s when runtime switches kernel under high-concurrency. Snippet: ```
2026-03-23T03:02:11Z ERROR router.proxy: upstream 502 - handshake mismatch; expected [meta,flags,seq], got [flags,meta,seq]
```
Looks like header permutation at kernel level.

alex: I can push a short-lived "handshake-guard" parser that tolerates both orders. Canary it to 2 router nodes. No client schema changes.

claire: Rollback plan: if user 5xx >0.4% sustained for 6m -> rollback runtime to v2.6.5 immediately. If errors persist after runtime rollback, enable `router.handshake_guard=true` permanently and reassess; if still failing, roll api back to v2.0.x. Order: runtime -> router-guard -> api. @sre-oncall confirm alerting thresholds?

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Creating alert: 5xx >0.4% for 6m -> notify #incidents + page PD. Will attach runbook steps for runtime rollback and router guard.

ux-console: We'll add a temporary banner and a telemetry probe that posts a tiny header-order check through the console path every 20s. If we flip the guard, we'll include `router.handshake_guard=true` in release notes.

dev-router: Starting canary on r-21 and r-22 (2/2). Watching p95, 5xx, and KV tail latencies; will report in ~7m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete, canary started (2/2). Full rollout estimated 18m after green.

alex: Canary: slight p95 bump (~28ms) on hot KV, 5xx stable. If p95 >230ms for 3m mark for rollback.

claire: Locking pin window 04:15-04:35 UTC. Release note draft: "runtime v2.7.0 — batching kernel reordering & perf; api v2.1.0 — forward-tolerant parsing; router — optional handshake-guard (auto-expire 90m)."

dev-router: handshake-guard will auto-expire 90m after rollout. Tagging rollout metadata `#handshake-guard` and adding console probe.

sre-oncall: Pager on standby. Escalate per alert rules.

alex: LGTM :white_check_mark:

claire: Thanks — keep signals here. If thresholds hit we'll follow rollback sequence.
